units.source_text: 光阴迅逝，岁月空度，六条宫邸内日渐冷落萧条，众侍女也逐渐散去了。

en.t: Time passed swiftly, the years slipped by in vain, and the Rokujo residence grew more desolate and neglected by the day, while the serving women gradually drifted away.

units.source_text: 加之这地方是偏近东郊的京极一带，各处山寺的晚钟都可听见。

en.t: Moreover, the place lay around Kyogoku near the eastern outskirts, so the evening bells from mountain temples in every direction could be heard.

units.source_text: 前斋宫住在这里，每闻钟声，时常嘤嘤啜泣。

en.t: The former Ise priestess lived there, and whenever she heard the bells, she would often break into soft sobs.

units.source_text: 同样是母女关系，而这前斋宫对母亲特别亲热：母亲在世之日，她几乎片刻不离膝下，两人相依为命。

en.t: Though many mothers and daughters are close, this former priestess had been especially devoted to her mother: while her mother lived, she was almost never away from her side, and the two depended on each other for everything.

units.source_text: 斋宫带母亲同行，是史无前例的，但她不顾破例，与母亲同赴伊势。

en.t: For an Ise priestess to take her mother with her was without precedent, yet she disregarded the breach of custom and went to Ise together with her mother.

units.source_text: 惟有此次母亲独赴冥途，她终于不能追随！

en.t: Only this time, when her mother went alone to the realm of the dead, she could not follow her after all.

units.source_text: 因此日夜悲伤，泪眼始终不干。

en.t: For that reason she grieved day and night, and her tearful eyes never dried.

units.source_text: 假手侍女而向前斋宫求爱的人，或贵或贱，不计其数。

en.t: Countless men, noble and lowborn alike, sought the former priestess in love through the mediation of her serving women.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣告诫乳母等人：“你等切不可自作主张，做出有失体统的事情来！”

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, warned the nurses and attendants, saying, "You must absolutely not act on your own and do anything improper."
His tone was very much that of a parent.

units.source_text: 乳母等都畏敬源氏内大臣的尊严，互相警戒：不可教内大臣听到不快之事。

en.t: The nurses all feared and respected the dignity of Genji, the Inner Minister, and warned one another not to let anything displeasing reach his ears.

units.source_text: 她们便绝不染指牵丝引线之事。

en.t: So they never involved themselves in any matchmaking or go-between affairs.
